# OLD policy-query baseline v1

Frozen before policy-constructor admission, from two actual Main/isolated
executions based on published processing checkpoint
832cdf5eab6e0474d82d864823a4cbcaaca1ea51.

snapshot.json is the complete parsed-equal body from both captures, serialized
as compact JSON plus newline. Only outer variant, source_sha256 and
published_checkpoint capture provenance was removed; both checkpoint values
were checked equal to the published revision. No output, lookup, work, typed
error, first processing product or actual second-query event was normalized.
The original pretty captures and exact source/executable pins remain in the
qualification evidence. Compact formatting reduces the frozen file from about
45 MB to 14 MB without dropping or deduplicating any field.

The body contains 973 ordinary and 411 sealed-finish seed observations over
33 checked parents (20 Root, 13 Domain), then dedicated dense/reached-fallback
and retained/boundary groups. There are 1,613 named actual policy-call
observations plus separate complete density-proof policies and current-query
results. Source Start is explicitly a one-field variant of the checked End
fixture. Independent calls at adjacent pages are never reconstructed into a
supposed whole output.

The dense case proves actual contents can exceed the output span cap. Two
Stage-witness cases reach and account a real second walk at fresh cap two.
The six wider-first cases refuse in their independently called current query;
they do not prove that a first-tape-length predicate reaches the second walk.
No construction-peak, partial-work API or native/DSP claim follows from this
ordinary metadata oracle.

Never regenerate this expected body after changing production policy behavior.
Add a new version or a separate witness for later evidence. snapshot.sha256
pins the exact compact bytes.
